messages:
sophie: Escalating a P1 from ZenithCare (on HIPAA addendum). They reported missing audit events for data-deletion exports during a window on 2026-03-04 02:00-03:30 UTC. Customer says export jobs returned 403s during a KMS key rotation and the exported manifest shows gaps. Need root cause, timeline, and confirmation on PHI exposure.

mike: Ack. Can you paste the export job_id + any request_ids and a sample 403 body? Also: are they on Dedicated/private KMS or hosted KMS alias?

zenithcare-admin: Job id: export-zen-20260304-02. Request ids: rq_4b2c9f7a, rq_4b2c9f7b, rq_4b2c9f8c. 403 body sample: `{"error":"forbidden","code":403,"detail":"KMS key not found for tenant"}`. We retried twice; second attempt succeeded for part of the window.

sophie: Repro steps from the customer:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" \
  -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/exports \
  -d '{"job_id":"export-zen-20260304-02","range":"2026-03-04T02:00:00Z/2026-03-04T03:30:00Z"}'
# -> HTTP/1.1 403 {"error":"forbidden","detail":"KMS key not found for tenant"}
```
They noted retries at 02:20 and 02:40 UTC. Some retries returned 200 and produced smaller manifests.

mike: Looking at infra traces: there was a KMS rotation action for tenant `zenithcare` at 2026-03-04T02:15:12Z. Node logs show a transient alias unlink event and a short window where requests to KMS returned 404/403 before alias propagation completed. Snippet:
```
[2026-03-04T02:15:12Z] INFO kms-service: rotate-key start tenant=zenithcare old_alias=alias/zenithcare/2026-02 new_alias=alias/zenithcare/2026-03
[2026-03-04T02:15:13Z] WARN kms-service: alias-unmapped tenant=zenithcare keyid=null
[2026-03-04T02:15:14Z] ERROR export-worker: encryption init failed job=export-zen-20260304-02 err="KMS: key not found"
[2026-03-04T02:25:43Z] INFO export-worker: retry succeeded job=export-zen-20260304-02 produced_objects=3
```

elena: We need to validate HSM/KMS attestation and confirm whether the rotation followed the documented zero-downtime procedure. Legal will want a signed timeline for the BAA. @ops-oncall please freeze any further auto-rotations for HIPAA tenants until we confirm.

audit-bot: Query on internal audit index shows 42 missing `delete` events in the 02:00-03:30 window for tenant zenithcare. Index reference: `audit://index/zenithcare/2026-03-04`. Export job aborted mid-window on first attempt.

ops-oncall: I ran the fallback rebind at 2026-03-04T02:26Z and requeued the export; some objects were uploaded to S3 after requeue. Collecting S3 object manifest now (will attach). Temporarily disabled scheduled rotation for alias/zenithcare/next.

mike: Hypothesis: rotation caused a temporary ARN/alias mismatch so export-worker couldn't decrypt or initialize envelope keys; some subranges aborted and produced partial manifests. Also noticed a retention flag mismatch in tenant config: `retention_days` was 30 for this tenant (should be 365 per HIPAA addendum). That explains potential missing deletions from daily retention reviews. Need product confirmation.

sophie: Customer asks for: 1) full timeline of rotation + key events, 2) list of missing audit event_ids, 3) statement on whether PHI was exposed or lost, 4) mitigation steps and long-term fix. Marked P1. I've looped in legal for BAA notification.

elena: I'll pull HSM logs and attestation chain, verify the rotation API call trace, and check if alias propagation failed due to metadata race. Opening internal ticket IN-2026-157 (security + infra). If attestation is clean we can provide a signed statement and replay exports.

sophie: ETA requested by customer for replayed manifests and missing-event list.

mike: ETA for full replay + manifest and missing event_ids: EOD UTC +1 (~6-8 hours) assuming HSM attestation doesn't require key recovery. If we need key rollback, ETA will increase. We'll include mitigations: patch rotation flow to block for active export-job locks and add health-check gating for alias propagation.

zenithcare-admin: Please confirm that deletions are permanent (i.e., not re-introduced) and that partial export doesn't mean audit trail loss. We need the missing event IDs to cross-check with our own logs.

sophie: We'll confirm retention policy and permanence. Will deliver missing event_ids and signed timeline as soon as ops provides manifest. Thanks all :thumbsup:

# next steps checklist:
- mike: provide infra trace links + export-worker error traces (in progress)
- ops-oncall: attach S3 manifest and re-run export for missing ranges (in progress)
- elena: HSM attestation + ticket IN-2026-157 (in progress)
- sophie: coordinate customer comms and legal BAA notice (in progress)

sophie: tagging this thread as P1-hipaa and moving to incident channel if we confirm loss of audit records.
